findings.motion: HB 958 Election Law Changes, second reading (House roll call 758, 66-47)
findings.note: His roll-call row lists 'Aye' on the second-reading vote for HB 958, the omnibus election bill. The House text of that date (sixth edition, https://www.ncleg.gov/Sessions/2025/Bills/House/PDF/H958v6.pdf) moves the deadline for a voter to bring photo ID after a provisional ballot from the third to the fifth business day after the election, does the same for the absentee-ballot ID photocopy, and requires a statement under penalty of perjury on citizenship on voter registration forms.

findings.motion: HB 958 amendment A2 (Blackwell), second reading (House roll call 756, 69-44)
findings.note: His roll-call row lists 'Aye' on amendment A2 to HB 958. The page does not say what A2 contains; the subject of the amendment is not confirmed.

findings.motion: HB 958 Election Law Changes, motion 11 to concur in the Senate version (House roll call 801, 62-47)
findings.note: His roll-call row lists 'Aye' on concurring in the Senate changes. The bill page (https://www.ncleg.gov/BillLookUp/2025/H958) shows it ratified 2026-08-06 and vetoed by the Governor 2026-08-17. The ratified text (https://www.ncleg.gov/Sessions/2025/Bills/House/PDF/H958v9.pdf) has a voter-registration part that requires a citizenship statement under penalty of perjury and a process to remove voters flagged as possible non-citizens by a federal database.
